summary.text: Patrick J. Carroll is a Democratic member of the New York State Assembly who has represented District 96 since January 2025 and is running for re-election on the Democratic and Working Families Party lines.
An attorney, he previously served on the Clarkstown Town Council.

paragraphs.text: Patrick J. Carroll graduated from Wesleyan University and Northeastern Law School.

He has practiced as an attorney since 2008, is admitted in New York, Massachusetts and Rhode Island, and previously served as legal counsel to the Rhode Island Department of Corrections and the Rhode Island State Senate Labor Committee.
Carroll served on the Clarkstown Town Council from 2017 to 2024 and was elected to the Assembly in November 2024.
He serves on the Consumer Affairs and Protection, Election Law, Governmental Employees, Judiciary, Oversight, Analysis and Investigation, and People with Disabilities committees.
He lives in Bardonia with his wife, Natalie, and their four daughters, and his biography notes his service as a CYO basketball coach.
